items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Because you lived on Rousseau and Jackson.

ctx.x: It was a perfectionary and a bar room. Because the sailors, and they used to come in there, were right on the river. They were right on the river. Yes. You see, they used to have horse cars there. Then later on they had electric cars. But it was mostly horse cars when they lived there. You see, because when it commenced to go down, then they moved farther in on Jackson Avenue. The neighborhood went down. And the grandmother died. So then they just kept moving in. Moved further into Jackson Avenue. Got more sedate.
Because you lived on Rousseau and Jackson.
I lived on Jackson and Rousseau. Jackson and Rousseau. Right next to the engine house.
